increase.en: There was a steady increase in the number of tourists after 2010.
increase.zh: 2010 年后,游客数量稳步增加。

increase.en: Spending on healthcare increased by ten percent between 2000 and 2010.
increase.zh: 2000 年至 2010 年间,医疗支出增加了百分之十。

decrease.en: The chart shows a decrease in the use of coal over the period.
decrease.zh: 图表显示,在此期间煤炭使用量有所减少。

decrease.en: The number of cinema visits decreased slightly during the following decade.
decrease.zh: 在随后的十年里,观影人次略有减少。

rise.en: There was a sharp rise in house prices between 2005 and 2007.
rise.zh: 2005 年至 2007 年间,房价急剧上升。

rise.en: Sales are expected to rise gradually over the next five years.
rise.zh: 预计未来五年销售额将逐步上升。

fall.en: There was a sharp fall in car sales between 2010 and 2015.
fall.zh: 2010 年至 2015 年间,汽车销量急剧下降。

fall.en: The proportion of households with a landline fell steadily over the period.
fall.zh: 在此期间,拥有固定电话的家庭比例持续下降。

decline.en: The chart shows a gradual decline in newspaper sales since 2000.
decline.zh: 图表显示,自 2000 年以来报纸销量逐渐下降。

decline.en: The number of farmers declined rapidly throughout the second half of the century.
decline.zh: 在二十世纪下半叶,农民数量迅速下降。

drop.en: There was a significant drop in the number of students in 2012.
Oil consumption dropped to its lowest level at the end of the period.
drop.zh: 在这一时期末,石油消费量下降到最低水平。

climb.en: The figure continued to climb, reaching a peak of eighty percent in 2015.
climb.zh: 这一数字持续攀升,在 2015 年达到百分之八十的峰值。

soar.en: The number of internet users soared from one million to ten million.
soar.zh: 互联网用户数量从一百万猛增到一千万。

surge.en: There was a surge in demand for electric cars after 2020.
surge.zh: 2020 年后,电动汽车的需求激增。

rocket.en: The price of petrol rocketed in the first half of the year.
rocket.zh: 汽油价格在上半年飞涨。

plummet.en: The value of exports plummeted from 50 million to 10 million dollars.
plummet.zh: 出口额从五千万美元暴跌到一千万美元。

plunge.en: The temperature plunges to below zero in the winter months.
plunge.zh: 冬季气温骤降到零度以下。

dip.en: After a slight dip in 2008, the figures began to rise again.
dip.zh: 2008 年略有下降之后,这些数字又开始上升。

dip.en: Sales dipped slightly in March before recovering in the following month.
dip.zh: 销售额在三月小幅下降,随后在下个月回升。

slump.en: The housing market experienced a slump at the beginning of the 1990s.
slump.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代初,住房市场经历了暴跌。

fluctuate.en: The price of wheat continued to fluctuate throughout the ten-year period.
fluctuate.zh: 在这十年间,小麦价格持续波动。

fluctuation.en: There were minor fluctuations in the rate of unemployment during this time.
fluctuation.zh: 在此期间,失业率有小幅波动。

stabilise.en: The number of visitors began to stabilise at around two million in 2018.
stabilise.zh: 2018 年,游客数量开始稳定在两百万左右。

level-off.en: Car ownership rose quickly and then began to level off after 2010.
level-off.zh: 汽车拥有量迅速上升,2010 年后开始趋于平稳。

plateau.en: Sales reached a plateau in 2015 and stayed unchanged for three years.
plateau.zh: 销售额在 2015 年进入平稳期,此后三年保持不变。

plateau.en: Most of the country's people live on a high plateau in the centre.
plateau.zh: 该国大部分人口居住在中部的高原上。

peak.en: The number of students reached a peak of 5,000 in 2012.
peak.zh: 学生人数在 2012 年达到 5000 人的顶峰。

peak.en: Electricity use peaked at around seven o'clock in the evening.
peak.zh: 用电量在晚上七点左右达到峰值。

bottom-out.en: The figures appeared to bottom out in 2009 and then slowly recovered.
bottom-out.zh: 这些数字似乎在 2009 年触底,然后缓慢回升。

remain-stable.en: The proportion of older workers is expected to remain stable until 2030.
remain-stable.zh: 预计到 2030 年,老年工人的比例将保持稳定。

steady.en: The graph shows a steady rise in the use of public transport.
steady.zh: 图表显示,公共交通的使用量平稳上升。

gradual.en: There was a gradual increase in the average age of the population.
gradual.zh: 人口平均年龄逐渐上升。

moderate.en: The middle group showed only a moderate change over the twenty years.
moderate.zh: 中间组在这二十年里只出现了适度的变化。

slight.en: There was a slight decrease in the number of people using buses.
slight.zh: 乘坐公交车的人数略有减少。

marginal.en: The difference between the two figures in 2005 was only marginal.
marginal.zh: 2005 年这两个数字之间的差异很小。

considerable.en: A considerable number of graduates went on to work overseas.
considerable.zh: 相当多的毕业生后来去了海外工作。

substantial.en: The chart shows a substantial increase in spending on online advertising.
substantial.zh: 图表显示,网络广告支出大幅增长。

significant.en: There was a significant difference between the salaries of men and women.
significant.zh: 男女工资之间存在显著差异。

dramatic.en: The use of mobile phones saw a dramatic rise during the 1990s.
dramatic.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代,手机使用量剧烈上升。

sharp.en: The table shows a sharp fall in the birth rate after 1960.
sharp.zh: 表格显示,1960 年后出生率急剧下降。

steep.en: There was a steep rise in the number of cars during the 1980s.
steep.zh: 20 世纪 80 年代,汽车数量急剧上升。

rapid.en: The rapid growth of cities has led to a shortage of housing.
rapid.zh: 城市的迅速发展导致了住房短缺。

exponential.en: The number of smartphone users showed exponential growth after 2008.
exponential.zh: 2008 年后,智能手机用户数量呈指数级增长。

overall.en: Overall, the proportion of people living in cities increased over the period.
overall.zh: 总体而言,在此期间城市人口比例有所上升。

trend.en: The overall trend shows that fewer people are buying printed books.
trend.zh: 总体趋势显示,购买纸质书的人越来越少。

pattern.en: A similar pattern can be seen in the figures for the other two countries.
pattern.zh: 另外两个国家的数字也呈现类似的模式。

proportion.en: The proportion of women in the workforce rose from 30 to 45 percent.
proportion.zh: 劳动力中女性的比例从百分之三十上升到百分之四十五。

percentage.en: The percentage of households with a computer doubled in only five years.
percentage.zh: 拥有电脑的家庭百分比在短短五年内翻了一番。

ratio.en: The ratio of teachers to students was highest in the smaller schools.
ratio.zh: 较小学校的师生比最高。

rate.en: The unemployment rate remained below five percent for most of the decade.
rate.zh: 这十年的大部分时间里,失业率保持在百分之五以下。

fraction.en: Only a small fraction of the waste was recycled in the first year.
fraction.zh: 第一年只有一小部分废物被回收。

majority.en: The majority of students preferred to live in shared flats.
majority.zh: 大多数学生更愿意住在合租公寓里。

minority.en: Only a small minority of people cycled to work in 2010.
minority.zh: 2010 年,只有少数人骑车上班。

quarter.en: Almost a quarter of the budget was spent on education.
quarter.zh: 近四分之一的预算用于教育。

quarter.en: Profits rose in the final quarter of the year after a difficult start.
quarter.zh: 经历了艰难的开局后,利润在第四季度有所上升。

double.en: The number of overseas students doubled between 2000 and 2010.
double.zh: 2000 年至 2010 年间,海外学生人数翻了一番。

triple.en: The population of the city tripled in less than thirty years.
triple.zh: 这座城市的人口在不到三十年内增至三倍。

halve.en: The number of smokers halved during the period shown on the graph.
halve.zh: 在图表所示时期内,吸烟人数减少了一半。

average.en: The average for the whole country was about twelve percent.
average.zh: 全国的平均数约为百分之十二。

average.en: The average price of a house rose by a third in ten years.
average.zh: 十年间,平均房价上涨了三分之一。

mean.en: The mean of the five results was thirty-two points.
mean.zh: 这五个结果的平均值是三十二分。

median.en: The median age of the population was thirty-five in 2010.
median.zh: 2010 年,人口年龄的中位数是三十五岁。

range.en: The prices cover a wide range, from two pounds to more than fifty.
range.zh: 价格范围很广,从两英镑到五十多英镑不等。

range.en: Ages in the group range from eighteen to sixty-five years old.
range.zh: 这个群体的年龄在十八岁到六十五岁之间。

total.en: Coal accounted for one third of the total energy used in that year.
total.zh: 煤炭占当年能源使用总量的三分之一。

total.en: The company employed a total of 500 people in the three factories.
total.zh: 这家公司在三家工厂共雇用了 500 人。

aggregate.en: The aggregate for the three years was just under two million.
aggregate.zh: 这三年的总计略低于两百万。

sum.en: The sum spent on advertising rose sharply in the final year.
sum.zh: 最后一年的广告支出总额急剧上升。

figure.en: The figure for France was twice as high as that for Spain.
figure.zh: 法国的数字是西班牙的两倍。

figure.en: Einstein is a key figure in the history of modern science.
figure.zh: 爱因斯坦是现代科学史上的关键人物。

amount.en: The amount of waste produced by each household fell over the period.
amount.zh: 在此期间,每户家庭产生的垃圾量有所减少。

quantity.en: The quantity of goods moved by rail remained the same.
quantity.zh: 铁路运输的货物数量保持不变。

capacity.en: The new power station has twice the capacity of the old one.
capacity.zh: 新发电站的容量是旧发电站的两倍。

margin.en: The opposition party won by a narrow margin in the 2015 election.
margin.zh: 反对党在 2015 年选举中以微弱差额获胜。

gap.en: The gap between the rich and the poor widened during the decade.
gap.zh: 这十年间,贫富差距扩大了。

discrepancy.en: There is a large discrepancy between the figures for the two regions.
discrepancy.zh: 这两个地区的数字之间存在很大差异。

disparity.en: The table reveals a great disparity in income between men and women.
disparity.zh: 表格显示男女收入存在巨大悬殊。

equivalent.en: Spending on food was equivalent to a third of average income.
equivalent.zh: 食品支出相当于平均收入的三分之一。

comparable.en: The figures for the two countries were comparable throughout the period.
comparable.zh: 这两个国家的数字在整个时期都是可比的。

respectively.en: Sales in Japan and Korea rose by ten and fifteen percent respectively.
respectively.zh: 日本和韩国的销售额分别增长了百分之十和百分之十五。

approximately.en: Approximately half of the people surveyed said they exercised regularly.
approximately.zh: 大约一半的受访者表示他们经常锻炼。

roughly.en: Roughly a third of the students came from other countries.
roughly.zh: 大致三分之一的学生来自其他国家。

nearly.en: Nearly seventy percent of households owned a car in 2010.
nearly.zh: 2010 年,近百分之七十的家庭拥有汽车。

exceed.en: The number of electric cars is expected to exceed that of diesel cars.
exceed.zh: 预计电动汽车的数量将超过柴油车。

surpass.en: Sales of online books may surpass those of printed ones by 2030.
surpass.zh: 到 2030 年,电子书销量可能超越纸质书。

overtake.en: Spain overtook Italy as the most popular destination in 2012.
overtake.zh: 2012 年,西班牙超过意大利,成为最受欢迎的目的地。

outnumber.en: Women outnumber men in most university courses in this country.
outnumber.zh: 在这个国家的大多数大学课程中,女性人数超过男性。

constitute.en: Older people constitute about a quarter of the total population.
constitute.zh: 老年人约占总人口的四分之一。

comprise.en: The group comprises twenty teachers from six different schools.
comprise.zh: 这个小组包含来自六所不同学校的二十名教师。

consist-of.en: The process consists of five main stages, beginning with the collection of materials.
consist-of.zh: 这个过程由五个主要阶段组成,首先是收集材料。

represent.en: Students represent the largest group of people using the library.
represent.zh: 学生占图书馆使用者的最大比例。

occupy.en: Farmland occupies the largest area of the town on both maps.
occupy.zh: 在两张地图上,农田都占据了该镇最大的面积。

distribution.en: The chart shows the distribution of wealth across the five regions.
distribution.zh: 图表显示了财富在五个地区的分布。

allocate.en: The government chose to allocate more money to health than to defence.
allocate.zh: 政府选择把更多资金分配给医疗,而不是国防。

projection.en: According to projections, the population will reach ten million by 2050.
projection.zh: 据预测,到 2050 年人口将达到一千万。

period.en: Sales rose steadily over the period from 2000 to 2010.
period.zh: 2000 年到 2010 年期间,销售额稳步上升。

decade.en: The number of cyclists increased steadily during the following decade.
decade.zh: 在接下来的十年里,骑自行车的人数持续增加。

century.en: The city's population grew rapidly in the early part of the century.
century.zh: 这座城市的人口在本世纪初迅速增长。

interval.en: Measurements were taken at regular intervals throughout the day.
interval.zh: 全天每隔一定时间进行一次测量。

annual.en: Annual sales rose from two million to five million over the period.
annual.zh: 在此期间,年销售额从两百万增长到五百万。

per-capita.en: Water use per capita was highest in the United States.
per-capita.zh: 美国的人均用水量最高。

enormous.en: There was an enormous difference between the two countries in 1990.
enormous.zh: 1990 年,这两个国家之间存在巨大差异。

tremendous.en: The new technology has had a tremendous effect on the way we shop.
tremendous.zh: 新技术对我们的购物方式产生了巨大影响。

abundant.en: The country has abundant natural resources but poor transport links.
abundant.zh: 这个国家自然资源丰富,但交通不便。

abundance.en: Developed countries enjoy an abundance of cheap food all year round.
abundance.zh: 发达国家全年都有丰富的廉价食品。

bulk.en: The bulk of the country's energy came from coal in 1990.
bulk.zh: 1990 年,该国的大部分能源来自煤炭。

rank.en: Germany ranked first in terms of the number of cars produced.
rank.zh: 就汽车产量而言,德国排名第一。

onwards.en: From 2010 onwards, the number of cyclists increased every single year.
onwards.zh: 从 2010 年起,骑自行车的人数逐年增加。

mid.en: Sales began to fall in the mid-1990s and never fully recovered.
mid.zh: 销售额从 20 世纪 90 年代中期开始下降,一直没有完全恢复。

bracket.en: People in the 25 to 34 age bracket spent the most on travel.
bracket.zh: 25 至 34 岁年龄段的人旅游支出最多。

axis.en: The vertical axis shows the number of people, measured in thousands.
axis.zh: 纵轴显示人数,单位为千。

slash.en: The company had to slash its advertising budget during the crisis.
slash.zh: 危机期间,这家公司不得不大幅削减广告预算。

upward.en: The graph shows a clear upward trend in the use of renewable energy.
upward.zh: 图表显示可再生能源的使用量呈明显的上升趋势。

millimetre.en: Average rainfall reached 200 millimetres in the wettest month.
millimetre.zh: 最潮湿的月份平均降雨量达到 200 毫米。

width.en: The width of the road increased from two lanes to four.
width.zh: 道路的宽度从两车道增加到四车道。

depth.en: Water is pumped up from a depth of about thirty metres.
depth.zh: 水从约三十米的深度被抽上来。

curve.en: The curve for France rises much more steeply than the others.
curve.zh: 法国的曲线比其他国家上升得陡峭得多。

slide.en: The company's share of the market continued to slide in 2015.
slide.zh: 2015 年,这家公司的市场份额继续下滑。

weekly.en: The chart shows the average weekly spending of students on food.
weekly.zh: 图表显示了学生每周在食品上的平均支出。

cumulative.en: The cumulative effect of small changes may be very large.
cumulative.zh: 小变化的累积效应可能非常大。

census.en: According to the last census, the city had about two million inhabitants.
census.zh: 根据最近一次人口普查,这座城市约有两百万居民。

stage.en: At the first stage of the process, the fruit is washed and sorted.
stage.zh: 在这一过程的第一阶段,水果被清洗和分拣。

phase.en: In the final phase, the finished products are sent to the shops.
phase.zh: 在最后阶段,成品被送往商店。

step.en: The next step involves heating the mixture to a high temperature.
step.zh: 下一步是把混合物加热到高温。

sequence.en: The diagram shows the sequence of events in the making of paper.
sequence.zh: 该图显示了造纸过程的先后顺序。

cycle.en: The diagram illustrates the life cycle of a salmon from egg to adult.
cycle.zh: 该图展示了鲑鱼从卵到成鱼的生命循环。

input.en: The main input of the process is fresh water from the river.
input.zh: 这一过程的主要投入是河里的淡水。

output.en: The factory's output doubled after the new machines were installed.
output.zh: 安装新机器后,工厂的产出翻了一番。

raw-material.en: Sand, the main raw material, is delivered to the factory by truck.
raw-material.zh: 主要原材料沙子由卡车运送到工厂。

extract.en: The oil is extracted from the seeds using a large machine.
extract.zh: 用大型机器从种子中提取油。

refine.en: The sugar is then refined to produce a fine white powder.
refine.zh: 然后把糖提炼成细白粉末。

filter.en: The water is filtered to remove any dirt before it is stored.
filter.zh: 水在储存前先过滤,以去除污垢。

filter.en: The dirty water passes through a filter made of sand and stones.
filter.zh: 脏水通过由沙子和石头制成的过滤器。

heat.en: The mixture is heated to about 100 degrees and left for one hour.
heat.zh: 混合物被加热到约 100 度,然后放置一小时。

cool.en: The glass is then cooled slowly to prevent it from breaking.
cool.zh: 然后把玻璃慢慢冷却,防止破裂。

dissolve.en: The salt is dissolved in warm water before being added to the tank.
dissolve.zh: 盐先溶解在温水中,然后加入水箱。

mix.en: The sand is mixed with water and small stones to form concrete.
mix.zh: 沙子与水和小石子混合,形成混凝土。

grind.en: The beans are ground into a fine powder by a large machine.
grind.zh: 咖啡豆被大型机器研磨成细粉。

crush.en: The rocks are crushed into small pieces before being transported.
crush.zh: 岩石先被压碎成小块,然后运走。

compress.en: The waste paper is compressed into large blocks at the recycling centre.
compress.zh: 废纸在回收中心被压缩成大块。

pump.en: Water is pumped from the river to a large tank on the hill.
pump.zh: 水从河里被抽送到山上的大水箱。

pump.en: A small electric pump moves the water through the pipes.
pump.zh: 一台小型电泵把水输送到管道中。

transport.en: The bottles are transported by lorry to the supermarkets.
transport.zh: 瓶子由卡车运输到超市。

package.en: Once dried, the tea leaves are packaged and transported to shops.
package.zh: 茶叶干燥后被包装并运往商店。

dispatch.en: The finished goods are dispatched to customers within two working days.
dispatch.zh: 成品在两个工作日内发送给顾客。

convert.en: The solar panels convert sunlight into electricity for the building.
convert.zh: 太阳能电池板把阳光转换成电力,供建筑使用。

transform.en: Heat from the sun transforms the water into vapour, which rises into the air.
transform.zh: 太阳的热量把水转化为水蒸气,升入空气中。

recycle.en: Glass bottles can be recycled again and again without any loss of quality.
recycle.zh: 玻璃瓶可以反复回收利用,质量不会受损。

construct.en: A new bridge was constructed across the river between the two maps.
construct.zh: 在两张地图所示时间之间,河上建造了一座新桥。

demolish.en: The old houses were demolished to make way for a shopping centre.
demolish.zh: 老房子被拆除,为购物中心腾出地方。

replace.en: The car park was replaced by a small garden and a playground.
replace.zh: 停车场被一个小花园和一个游乐场取代。

relocate.en: The school was relocated to the north of the town in 2005.
relocate.zh: 这所学校于 2005 年迁到了镇子北部。

expand.en: The airport was expanded to include a second terminal and a new runway.
expand.zh: 机场进行了扩建,增加了第二座航站楼和一条新跑道。

extend.en: The railway line was extended to the east of the town.
extend.zh: 铁路线延伸到了镇子东部。

convert-a-into-b.en: The old warehouses were converted into flats during the 1990s.
convert-a-into-b.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代,这些旧仓库被改造成公寓。

redevelop.en: The area around the port was redeveloped with shops and restaurants.
redevelop.zh: 港口周边地区被重新开发,建起了商店和餐馆。

renovate.en: The old museum was renovated and now has a much larger entrance.
renovate.zh: 老博物馆翻新后,现在有了大得多的入口。

pedestrianise.en: The main street was pedestrianised, and cars are no longer allowed.
pedestrianise.zh: 主街被改为步行区,不再允许汽车通行。

insert.en: The sheets of paper are inserted into the machine one at a time.
insert.zh: 纸张被一张一张地插入机器。

flip.en: The bricks are flipped over halfway through the drying process.
flip.zh: 砖块在干燥过程进行到一半时被翻转。

blend.en: The fruit is blended with sugar and water to produce juice.
blend.zh: 水果与糖和水混合,制成果汁。

chop.en: The vegetables are chopped into small pieces and then cooked.

trim.en: The edges of the paper are trimmed before the book is bound.
trim.zh: 书籍装订前,要修剪纸张的边缘。

soak.en: The seeds are soaked in water overnight to make them softer.
soak.zh: 种子在水中浸泡一夜,使其变软。

flush.en: The pipes are flushed with clean water to remove any remaining chemicals.
flush.zh: 用清水冲洗管道,以去除残留的化学物质。

drill.en: Workers drill a deep hole to reach the water under the ground.
drill.zh: 工人钻一个深孔,以取得地下水。

load.en: The finished bricks are loaded onto trucks and delivered to customers.
load.zh: 成品砖被装上卡车,送到顾客手中。
